name: yumi-site
description: A one-page introduction + booking site for Yumi N., a certified Japanese tutor, modeled on the structure and booking flow of sakurajapaneselesson.com: hero, 3 reasons, about, lesson menu, price, on-site booking (Sakura-style single pane: month calendar + start-time dropdown + duration + live total), student voices, FAQ, and booking management.
